factual_methodology.summary: Verified original OWID 1971 2,308 and 2021 58.2 billion transistor observations, and IEA 2024 data-centre electricity mix 30% coal, 27% renewable, 26% natural gas and 15% nuclear. Dated empirical evidence used as contextual comparator, not proof of ideological effects.

research_depth.summary: Each locale contains documented extended biography, chronology and causes, at least 3900 words, six or more substantive sections.

evidence_traceability.summary: All numbered source references exist, diversified bibliography, key numeric and document identities spot-checked against original sources.

counterfactual_review.summary: Theory, claims by political actors, measured social outcomes and unsupported speculation are distinguished.

visual_evidence_readiness.summary: Two independent source-grounded numeric graphics, period/unit definitions, equivalent numeric series in both languages, plus causal and geographic diagrams and table.

editorial_publication_readiness.summary: Corrected r1 rejection: no broken internal links to unapproved pieces and no purely chronological graphics.

contrary_evidence: Descriptive data do not establish the individual's political influence or effectiveness of proposed institutions.
Interpretation of theoretical corpus is debated in specialist literature.
limitations: Cross-checked decisive empirical indicators and bibliographic identities; did not test every external host for permanent availability.
The editorial study does not endorse antidemocratic or other political proposals of the subject.
notes: Review pass performed against r2 files, cross-checking empirical indicators and revisiting r1 rejection findings. Hash-bound approval only for these exact bilingual contents.
